description.value: Afternoon matinee show plan: pick up discounted seats at a TKTS booth. TDF says to visit a TKTS Discount Booth for same-day performances and next-day matinees up to 50% off. For gifts, TDF suggests you Share the gift of live theatre with TKTS eGift Cards. TDF also points buyers to its TKTS app, which has a real-time display of what’s currently on sale at all TKTS Discount Booths.
